power.summary: Five of six tracked Alabama power positions have publicly documented Christian affiliations in the sources reviewed. Because 5 of 6 are documented Christian, a majority of the tracked set is documented Christian; the House speaker remains unknown rather than inferred.

officeholders.affiliation_detail: Official governor biography states she is a member of First Baptist Church of Montgomery.
officeholders.source_note: Current office and church membership are both documented by the official governor biography.

officeholders.affiliation_detail: Official lieutenant-governor biography states he previously worked as a youth pastor at Grace Fellowship Church.
officeholders.source_note: Broad Christian affiliation is supported by the official pastoral biography; no denomination is assigned from that source.

officeholders.name: Steve Marshall
officeholders.affiliation_detail: Official attorney-general biography states he is a member of Church of the Highlands in Montgomery.
officeholders.source_note: Church membership is explicitly stated in the official biography.

officeholders.name: Sarah H. Stewart
